title: Subaward Agreement Extraction — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for a fully executed subaward agreement (Pass-Through Entity → Subrecipient) distilled into nine sections used for research-administration setup and ongoing monitoring. UDM-aligned to Award, Subaward, Organization, Personnel, ContactDetails, IndirectRate, CostShare, AwardDeliverable, Modification, Terms, ConflictOfInterest.

pte_name.description: Pass-Through Entity name. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Name.

subrecipient_name.description: Subrecipient organization name. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Name.

federal_award_number.description: PTE Federal Award Number (FAIN). Resolves to UDM Award.Federal_Award_ID. Required by source workflow.

subaward_number.description: Subaward number. Resolves to UDM Subaward.Subaward_Number.

project_title.description: Full project title. Resolves to UDM Award.Award_Title.

federal_awarding_agency.description: Federal awarding agency name. Required by source workflow.

pte_pi.description: PTE Principal Investigator. Resolves to UDM Personnel.

subrecipient_pi.description: Subrecipient PI. Resolves to UDM Subaward.PI_Name + Personnel.

budget_period_start.description: Subaward budget period start date. Resolves to UDM Subaward.Start_Date.

budget_period_end.description: Subaward budget period end date. Resolves to UDM Subaward.End_Date.

amount_funded.description: Amount funded this action. Resolves to UDM Subaward.Subaward_Amount. Cross-field check CHK-01: amount_funded == total_direct_costs + total_indirect_costs when all three present.

invoicing_frequency.description: Resolves to UDM Terms.Invoicing_Frequency. Required by source workflow.

technical_reports.description: Required technical reports. Resolves to UDM AwardDeliverable. Empty array when none required.

financial_reports.description: Required financial reports. Resolves to UDM AwardDeliverable. Empty array when none required.

source.description: Document section / attachment that calls it out.

prior_approval_handling.description: General prior-approval policy. Resolves to UDM Modification.Requires_Prior_Approval.

coi_policy.description: Conflict of interest policy application. Resolves to UDM ConflictOfInterest.
